title: Flow Matching for Sampled-Data Control of Angular Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2611.20360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synchronization and clustering in oscillator networks depend on the joint distribution of the phases. Flow Matching can steer this distribution by learning an angular velocity field from shortest arcs between paired configurations. Each arc is traversed at constant speed, yet the resulting field can vary along its own trajectories. In this article, we study how to control angular transport on the circle and product torus when each controller evaluation selects a rate to hold until the next update. Using the same local velocity samples, Flow Matching learns the instantaneous angular rate and MeanFlow learns its average along the reference trajectory over the control interval. Under direct angular actuation, holding the exact average gives the reference displacement. We relate the displacement error of holding the instantaneous rate and the training residual of MeanFlow to the conditional covariance of the teacher velocities. Experiments w

translated_title: 面向角分布采样数据控制的流匹配方法
translated_abstract: 振子网络中的同步与聚集现象依赖于相位的联合分布。流匹配可以通过从成对构型之间的最短弧学习角速度场来引导该分布。每条弧以恒定速度被遍历，但由此得到的速度场可以沿其自身轨迹发生变化。在本文中，我们研究了在每次控制器评估选定一个速率并保持到下一次更新之前的情况下，如何控制圆周与乘积环面上的角度输运。利用相同的局部速度样本，流匹配学习瞬时角速率，而 MeanFlow 学习其在控制区间内沿参考轨迹的平均角速率。在直接角度驱动下，保持精确的平均速率即可实现参考位移。我们将保持瞬时速率所产生的位移误差以及 MeanFlow 的训练残差与教师速度的条件协方差联系起来。实验（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出利用流匹配与 MeanFlow 从成对构型的最短弧中学习角速度场，实现对圆周及乘积环面上相位分布的采样保持式控制，并证明在控制区间内保持平均角速率即可复现参考位移，其误差与教师速度的条件协方差相关联。
en_tdlr: This paper employs Flow Matching and MeanFlow to learn angular velocity fields from shortest arcs between paired configurations for sampled-data hold-based control of phase distributions on the circle and product torus, showing that holding the interval-averaged angular rate reproduces the reference displacement, with errors tied to the conditional covariance of teacher velocities.
